name: In Favor of Elune
label: Quest
description: Young night elf priests leave Shadowglen for guidance and training in Dolanaar. Priestess Shanda sends them along the forest path to Laurna Morninglight.

clips.title: The story
paras: Young night elf priests leave Shadowglen for guidance and training in Dolanaar. Priestess Shanda sends them along the forest path to Laurna Morninglight.

Priestess Shanda trains initiates serving Elune within Aldrassil's secluded shelter. Their learning begins with simple prayers and defensive invocations under her watchful eye. Shadowglen's cloistered life cannot prepare a priestess or priest for the turmoil gripping the wider world. Once an initiate shows steady faith and discipline, Shanda sends them down the shadowed forest path toward Dolanaar to continue their education.

Reaching Dolanaar marks an essential milestone in a night elf's divine vocation. There, respected priestess Laurna Morninglight prepares disciples for the trials facing Teldrassil. The acolyte can receive advanced instruction in moonlit spellcraft and claim their first formal vestments, marking their official standing within the Sisterhood of Elune.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a priest of Elune.
Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, friend. Teaching young priests the ways of Elune gives me great satisfaction.
